user.title: Connect an Omarchy PC
user.description: Enter the address of a PC running omahassd. The pairing key is shown in the Omarchy bar under Home Assistant → This PC, or with `omahassd key`.

pair.title: Pair {name}
pair.description: Found **{name}** at {host}. Enter the pairing key shown in the Omarchy bar under Home Assistant → This PC.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-pair {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The PC no longer accepts the saved pairing key. Enter the current one from the Omarchy bar.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the PC. Is omahassd running and the port open?
error.invalid_key: The PC rejected that pairing key.

abort.already_configured: This PC is already set up.

send_actionable.name: Send actionable notification
send_actionable.description: Show a desktop notification with buttons. A press fires the omahass_notification_action event.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: Returned with the action event so automations can tell notifications apart.
